about: Labels changed by hand, each with the library source that shows it (bench/holdout/README.md: call breaks found by binding are checked against the source at `to`, here read from the release's wheel). A use overridden here is excluded.

overrides.probe: breaks (param_removed): the model's generated signature has no `text` field
overrides.why: at 0.14.25 Document declares its own `__init__(self, **data)`, which keeps backward compatibility: a `text` keyword is moved into `text_resource` (and `doc_id`, `extra_info` likewise), so `Document(text=...)` still works; the generated pydantic signature lists only the fields
overrides.evidence: llama_index_core-0.14.25 wheel, llama_index/core/schema.py line 1104 (Document.__init__: "If 'text' was passed, store it in 'text_resource'.")

overrides.probe: breaks (param_not_yet_added): the model's generated signature has no `llm`
overrides.why: at 0.0.109 SQLDatabaseToolkit is a pydantic v1 model (BaseToolkit(BaseModel)) whose Config sets only arbitrary_types_allowed, so pydantic v1's default Extra.ignore drops an unknown keyword: `llm=` is accepted and ignored, not an error
overrides.evidence: langchain-0.0.109 wheel, langchain/agents/agent_toolkits/sql/toolkit.py (class Config: arbitrary_types_allowed = True) and agent_toolkits/base.py (class BaseToolkit(BaseModel), no Config)

overrides.probe: breaks (param_not_yet_added): the model's generated signature has no `expected_output`
overrides.why: at 0.1.2 Task is a pydantic.v1 BaseModel with no Config (Extra.ignore), so `expected_output=` is accepted and dropped, not an error; as 2026-11c's crewai 0.1.32 Task
overrides.evidence: crewai-0.1.2 wheel, crewai/task.py (class Task(BaseModel) from pydantic.v1, fields description, agent, tools; no Config)
